principle: Repository controls may be completed autonomously; authoritative evidence and owner permissions may not be inferred.

public-evidence-refresh.promotion_limit: No displacement, baseline, payer, HTA, policy, regulatory, empirical, or calibrated claim.

closure_criteria: attributable NHS or accountable local record
intervention, comparator, displaced programme, and stable programme ID
nhs-displacement.autonomous_next_step: Continue bounded allow-listed monitoring and preserve explicit negative receipts.
nhs-displacement.stop_condition: Do not infer local displacement from national guidance or aggregate context.

closure_criteria: owner approval bound to the same revision
atlas-approved-packet.autonomous_next_step: Keep ingestion, hash-binding, panel, stale-source, and requalification checks ready.
atlas-approved-packet.stop_condition: Do not promote candidate parameters or use mutable/latest releases.

raw-and-confidential-data.autonomous_next_step: Use public aggregate, redacted, or synthetic inputs only.
raw-and-confidential-data.stop_condition: No restricted payload access, transfer, computation, or export.

closure_criteria: owner authorization bound to the final commit
release-authorization.autonomous_next_step: Run repository qualification and publish only research-only outputs.
release-authorization.stop_condition: Keep empirical, payer, HTA, policy, regulatory, and calibrated claims disabled.

refresh_and_invalidation.required_action: Regenerate packet freeze, panel receipts, readiness, and downstream projections after any material source or commit change.
